description: The ua module on /sync (Prebid.js's pixelUrl) without SID_SKIP_BOTS: it runs there for its bot check alone, reports ok for a client whose User-Agent names it as a bot and empty for a browser, and changes nothing else: the ID is set as before, from the id parameter. skip-bots-ua-sync.json has the same requests with SID_SKIP_BOTS=declared.

cases.name: a client that names itself as a bot still gets the ID without SID_SKIP_BOTS
a browser's request is unchanged, and the module reports empty
